title: a_city_near_centaurus__doede
author: Doede, William R.
summary: On Alpha Centauri II, an Earth archeologist named Michaelson clashes with Maota, the self-appointed keeper of an ancient alien city, over whether to preserve or leave the ruins untouched; their conflict ends when Maota uses a device that transports only the mind to another dimension, and Michaelson discovers his teleportation cylinder lets him return to his body while Maota cannot.
